rationale.quality: 6x6/64 pixels rejects tiny ROIs; >35% torso overlap abstains. A requires each stripe color to occupy >=2.5% of the torso. These are explicit engineering safeguards, not label-tuned accuracy thresholds.
rationale.temporal: Retain upstream 20-observation history; require 3 votes and 65% majority. Current unknown/conflicting evidence abstains. Referee veto applies immediately. Reset memory after >10 missing frames.
rationale.calibration: Final HSV boxes are measured cluster quantiles. Score thresholds are the 10th percentile of automatically dominant appearance anchors; no human object labels. Floors prevent zero-score or exact-tie acceptance. Calibration and demonstration share these frames, so this is not held-out evaluation.
